question: Find the surface area of a sphere whose diameter is equal to 54 cm
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area of a sphere = 4πr²

Given diameter = 54 cm, so radius = 27 cm.

Area = 4 × π × 27² = 4 × 729 × π

Unit digit trick: The units digit of 4 × 9 is 6.

Among the given options, only 2916π ends in 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 2916π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere (d) = 54 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4πr²

Radius (r) = d ÷ 2

 
 

 

 
 
• 
 r = 27 cm
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Diameter = 54 cm

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius (r) = 54 ÷ 2 = 27 cm

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (27)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 729

⇒ Surface Area = 2916π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 2916π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The total 3D space occupied by a sphere is given by the formula V = (4÷3)πr³.

Surface Area of a Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr² | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr².

Volume of a Hemisphere

Exactly half the volume of a complete sphere, calculated as V = (2÷3)πr³.
